universeContext: One of the fixed 101 original 2026 Melbourne Cup nominees.

verifiedFacts.latestResultContext: Won the Group 3 Colin Stephen Quality (2400m) at Rosehill on Saturday 26 September 2026.
verifiedFacts.handicappingContext: Racing Victoria stated So You Are carried 58.5kg in the Colin Stephen Quality. The Melbourne Cup penalty was 0.5kg. He was not penalised in the Caulfield Cup; his relative WFA position improved.
